layout.architecture: Grid layout with no rounded corners (rounded-none). Heavy use of border-collapse and 1px solid borders to create a technical, segmented view.

SwarmCommandCenter.style: Terminal-style input box. Background #0A0A0A, border #222222. Prefix with '>' or '$'. Focus should glow the border with #00FF41.

LiveAgentPulse.style: 8x8 CSS Grid. gap-1. Each cell represents an agent. Active agents: border #00FF41, text #00FF41, slight bg tint. Dead agents: border #222222, text #404040. Display tiny ID and energy bar in cell if space permits.

KCUValidator.style: Stacked input fields. Minimalist lines. border-b only for inputs. Data readout for resonance, hash_energy should look like a CLI readout (key: value).

SultanCoinLedger.style: Dense data table. border-b #222222 on rows. text-xs. tabular-nums. Monospace alignment for columns.

motion.interactions: Instant or very fast (75ms). No bouncy easing. It should feel like a machine.
motion.real_time_updates: Briefly flash row/cell background to white or #00FF41 when data changes, then fade back to dark.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #808080 text on #0A0A0A background meets at least 4.5:1. Increase brightness if necessary.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Disable real-time flashes if user prefers reduced motion.

images.description: Abstract black metallic texture. Use as a fixed background with 5-10% opacity overlay to add depth without distracting from data.

assets.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer geometric/sharp icons over rounded ones (e.g., Terminal, Activity, Key, Database).

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter or rounded corners anywhere. Use rounded-none for all elements.
Implement the components exactly as styled: raw, technical, terminal-like.
Mock the WebSocket data hook. The 64 agents should have random states that update periodically.
The KCU Validator should run a mock transformation showing the 0x5F3759DF constant in the UI results.
Ensure the layout fits well on a standard 1080p desktop monitor, typical for control room dashboards.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
